stock.description: Metasurface Technologies Holdings Limited offers specialized precision engineering solutions to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and contract manufacturers (CMs) located in Singapore. A core aspect of its services involves precision machining, utilizing computer numerical control (CNC) machines and other advanced tools to meticulously cut, shape, and produce intricate parts. The company also provides expert precision welding, employing sophisticated methods such as laser and electron beam processes to effectively join materials. Beyond these services, Metasurface Technologies manufactures and supplies specialized components, including ultra-high and high vacuum weldments, as well as ultra-high and high purity gas line weldments. Its client base spans the semiconductor, aerospace, and data storage industries. Established in 2000, the company is headquartered in Singapore.
